errors.evidence: The x-axis has tick labels for every year from 2011 to 2024, not every two years.
The description states that the markers are triangles ('Dreiecksmarkierungen'), but the chart shows they are circles for all three lines.

errors.text_span: beginnt bei einem Wert von 7,1 im Jahr 2011 und erreicht ihren Höchststand von 7,3 im Jahr 2018, bevor sie ab 2019 einen minimalen Wert von 7,0 erreicht
errors.evidence: The values for the 'Jugendliche und junge Erwachsene' (light blue) line are incorrect. It starts at ~7.3 (not 7.1), peaks at ~7.6 in 2019 (not 7.3 in 2018), and has a minimum of ~6.6 in 2021 (not 7.0).
The line representing 'Erwachsene' (adults) is dark blue, not red ('rote').

errors.text_span: erreicht ihren Höchststand von 7,2 im Jahr 2017, bevor sie ab 2019 einen minimalen Wert von 6,8 erreicht
errors.evidence: The values for the 'Erwachsene' (dark blue) line are incorrect. The peak is ~7.2 in 2019 and 2024 (not 2017), and the minimum is ~6.6 in 2021 (not 6.8).
The line representing 'Senioren' (seniors) is purple, not dark pink ('dunkelrosa').

errors.text_span: erreicht im Jahr 2023 einen Höchststand von 7,2
errors.evidence: The peak for the 'Senioren' (purple) line is incorrect. The value in 2023 is approximately 6.7, and the line never reaches 7.2. Its actual peak is at approximately 7.0 in 2011.
The description completely omits the error bars that are present on every data point for all three lines.
